snippet.title: Ajnabee - The Unknown Game Trailer | New Horror Cinematic Hindi Indian Game | Akshat Softwares
snippet.description:
AJNABEE: THE UNKNOWN | Official Game Trailer

Wishlist Ajnabee: The Unknown on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4259690/Ajnabee__The_Unknown/

Play the FREE Demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4265910/Ajnabee__The_Unknown_Demo/



Ajnabee: The Unknown is a cinematic, story-driven psychological horror game set in India, where fear isn't created through constant jump scares—but through atmosphere, suspense, and the unsettling feeling that someone is always watching.

Please Note: This is not a jump scare–heavy horror game. The horror is built through immersive storytelling, realistic environments, psychological tension, and cinematic presentation.

What would you do...

...if someone entered your home,

changed things quietly,

and left before you could ever see them?

You play as Naina, a young woman whose ordinary life slowly begins to unravel as an unseen presence starts interfering with her reality. Small changes become impossible to ignore. Every room feels different. Every sound becomes suspicious. Every day brings a new mystery.

Explore, investigate, and survive as you uncover the truth behind the unknown presence in this immersive first-person horror experience inspired by everyday life in India.

Features

• 🎬 Cinematic, narrative-driven gameplay
• 👁️ Psychological horror with minimal jump scares
• 🏠 Immersive first-person exploration
• 🇮🇳 Authentic Indian setting and atmosphere
• 🧩 Environmental storytelling and mysteries
• 🎧 Rich sound design for maximum immersion

Developed by: Akshat Softwares
Releasing On 10 August 2026 For PC On STEAM

If you enjoyed the trailer, don't forget to:
👍 Like the video
💬 Leave a comment with your thoughts
🔔 Subscribe for development updates, gameplay videos, and future announcements
